Federal courts currently face significant challenges in adjudicating habeas corpus claims, particularly regarding the deference owed to state court decisions under the Antiterrorism and Effective Death Penalty Act of 1996 (AEDPA).  - Federal courts are obligated to defer to state court rulings unless they conflict with established Supreme Court precedent.

This technique leverages social media feeds and involves mechanisms to cloak, watermark, and anchor comments to influence future responses of AI models, achieving a high effectiveness rate. A proposed defense mechanism has also been developed to reduce the impact of these attacks.

 - Indirect Bias Injection Attacks manipulate AI agents' behavior through external content.
 - The technique achieves high adversary-aligned response rates across various AI tasks.
 - A defense mechanism has been proposed to mitigate the effects of these attacks.

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22061

Recent research reveals that many large language models employ stateless defenses that can be easily exploited through decomposition attacks, where harmful tasks are broken into acceptable requests. To effectively combat these attacks, a stateful monitoring system capable of linking requests and identifying harmful patterns is necessary, as traditional approaches are ineffective against attackers leveraging unlinkable identities and varying request patterns.

 - Decomposition attacks can bypass defenses by splitting harmful requests into individually permissible ones.
 - Effective countermeasures require stateful monitoring to group requests, which is challenged by unlinkable identities.

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.17445
